items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I was playing along with Lionel Hampton records and Benny Goodman records and Duke Ellington records and Count Basie and Monk.

ctx.x: Is it true that your father attached wooden blocks to your feet so that you could reach the pedals?
Yes. And I was playing along with Lionel Hampton records and Benny Goodman records and Duke Ellington records and Count Basie and Monk. You know? Whatever I was listening to.
And you stated in some of your bios that at age 11 you were playing for strippers and that it opened your eyes?
